reason: Upstream gives the Bite count as 'Number of Heads', which no fixed count represents. The Multiple Heads trait starts the hydra at five heads, so the engine makes five Bites and an agent clause tracks lost and regrown heads.
citation: hydra actions.multiattack.desc: "The hydra makes as many Bite attacks as it has heads."; special_abilities.multiple-heads.desc: "The hydra has five heads."

value: The hydra makes one Bite per living head (Multiple Heads). The engine assumes the starting five, so the agent overrides the Bite count as heads die or regrow.
reason: Pairs with the five-Bite multiattack: the head count changes during combat and only the agent tracks it.
